summary: Transglobal Management Group (f/k/a The Marquie Group) filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing a September 30 Unwind and Settlement Agreement with Marc and Jacquie Angell and GetGolf.com, LLC. GetGolf admitted failing to make required payments under the January 19, 2026 Amended Purchase Agreement, defaulting uncured for at least 90 days, and waived cure rights. Control reverts: Foster and Kirchhoff surrender 200 Series A Preferred shares for cancellation, and 200 new Series A shares are issued to Angell. Foster resigns all officer and director positions; Kirchhoff resigns officer roles but remains a director pending deferred resignation.
